## 3. Likely Corrections

Items likely for v0.5 (not implemented now):

1. **Simplify some demo-only panels** that explain the product instead of simulating it.
2. **Distinguish real product modules** from demo explanatory blocks (labels / sections).
3. **Make role-specific navigation clearer** (Admin / Specialist / Lead / Client views).
4. **Clarify what SEO specialist fills** vs what monthly view **aggregates**.
5. **Improve evidence/screenshot model** (approved vs draft; client-visible flag).
6. **Make published snapshot concept visible** (version badge, “not live draft”).
7. **Add user role switcher** or Admin / SEO / Client mode switch for demos.
8. **Maybe reduce visual noise** before showing to external reviewers (when feedback charter opens).
